# Cold War Project: decolonization in Africa, scripted buttons (generated by gen_africa2.py; edit freely). Cooldowns are <button>_cd variables.

### Gold Coast: three milestones, then Britain decides
cwp_gold_constitution_button = {
	name = "cwp_gold_constitution_button"
	desc = "cwp_gold_constitution_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:GBR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_gold_no_constitution_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_gold_constitution_adopted }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_gold_constitution_button_possible_tt
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
					global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 1
				}
				c:GLC ?= { liberty_desire >= 40 }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_global_variable = cwp_gold_constitution_adopted
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_gold_constitution_cost
			months = 24
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_small
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 10
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
	}
}

cwp_gold_detentions_button = {
	name = "cwp_gold_detentions_button"
	desc = "cwp_gold_detentions_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:GBR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_gold_no_election_won_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_gold_election_won }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_gold_detentions_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_gold_detentions_button_cd
			months = 24
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_gold_detentions
			months = 12
		}
		change_infamy = 2
		c:GLC ?= { add_liberty_desire = -10 }
		c:GLC ?= {
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = -15
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 3
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } add = 7 }
	}
}

cwp_gold_independence_button = {
	name = "cwp_gold_independence_button"
	desc = "cwp_gold_independence_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:GBR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_gold_not_granted_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_gold_independence_granted }
		}
		cwp_gold_milestones_met = yes
	}

	effect = {
		set_global_variable = cwp_gold_independence_granted
		custom_tooltip = cwp_gold_independence_button_effect_tt
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 10
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 20 }
		if = { limit = { scaled_debt > 0.5 } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { c:GLC ?= { liberty_desire >= 75 } } add = 20 }
	}
}

cwp_gold_election_button = {
	name = "cwp_gold_election_button"
	desc = "cwp_gold_election_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:GLC ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_gold_constitution_adopted_tt
			has_global_variable = cwp_gold_constitution_adopted
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_gold_no_election_won_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_gold_election_won }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_gold_no_campaign_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_gold_campaign_running }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_gold_election_button_possible_tt
			NOT = { c:GBR ?= { has_variable = cwp_gold_detentions } }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_global_variable = {
			name = cwp_gold_campaign_running
			months = 6
		}
		custom_tooltip = cwp_gold_election_button_effect_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			trigger_event = { id = cwp_africa.4 days = 180 popup = yes }
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 15
	}
}

### Kenya: the rising is liberty desire; the JE is bound to the detained leader
cwp_kenya_emergency_button = {
	name = "cwp_kenya_emergency_button"
	desc = "cwp_kenya_emergency_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:GBR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_kenya_emergency_button_possible_tt
			has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_rising
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_kenya_emergency_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_kenya_emergency_button_cd
			months = 12
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_kenya_emergency_cost
			months = 12
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		change_infamy = 3
		c:KKY ?= { add_liberty_desire = -15 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_leader_detained }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_leader_martyred }
				has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_leader
				global_var:cwp_kenya_leader ?= { is_character_alive = yes }
			}
			custom_tooltip = cwp_kenya_detain_leader_tt
			set_global_variable = cwp_kenya_leader_detained
			c:KKY ?= { add_modifier = { name = cwp_kenya_leader_in_detention } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_emergencies } }
			set_global_variable = { name = cwp_kenya_emergencies value = 0 }
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = cwp_kenya_emergencies add = 1 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 15
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes } add = 10 }
		if = { limit = { c:KKY ?= { liberty_desire >= 70 } } add = 20 }
	}
}

cwp_kenya_release_button = {
	name = "cwp_kenya_release_button"
	desc = "cwp_kenya_release_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:GBR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_kenya_leader_detained_tt
			has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_leader_detained
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_kenya_release_button_possible_tt
			OR = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_rising_crushed
				c:KKY ?= { liberty_desire >= 80 }
				AND = {
					has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
					global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 3
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		remove_global_variable = cwp_kenya_leader_detained
		c:KKY ?= {
			remove_modifier = cwp_kenya_leader_in_detention
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = 20
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 5
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 15 }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 3 } add = 15 }
	}
}

cwp_kenya_conference_button = {
	name = "cwp_kenya_conference_button"
	desc = "cwp_kenya_conference_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:GBR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_kenya_no_conference_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_conference_held }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_kenya_leader_not_detained_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_leader_detained }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_kenya_tide_75_tt
			has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
			global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 3
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_kenya_conference_button_possible_tt
			OR = {
				cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes
				has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_rising_crushed
				has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_leader_martyred
				c:KKY ?= { liberty_desire >= 75 }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_global_variable = cwp_kenya_conference_held
		custom_tooltip = cwp_kenya_conference_button_effect_tt
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 10
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 20 }
		if = { limit = { c:KKY ?= { liberty_desire >= 75 } } add = 15 }
	}
}

### Belgian Congo: a race between preparation and the outside world
cwp_congo_cadres_button = {
	name = "cwp_congo_cadres_button"
	desc = "cwp_congo_cadres_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:BEL ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_congo_cadres_button_possible_tt
			global_var:cwp_congo_cadres < 3
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_congo_cadres_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_congo_cadres_button_cd
			months = 24
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_congo_cadres_cost
			months = 24
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = cwp_congo_cadres add = 1 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 10
		if = { limit = { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes } add = 5 }
	}
}

### Portuguese Africa: three fronts
cwp_portugal_counter_insurgency_button = {
	name = "cwp_portugal_counter_insurgency_button"
	desc = "cwp_portugal_counter_insurgency_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:POR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_portugal_counter_insurgency_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_portugal_counter_insurgency_button_cd
			months = 12
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_portugal_counter_insurgency_cost
			months = 12
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_medium
		}
		change_infamy = 2
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_portugal_campaigns } }
			set_global_variable = { name = cwp_portugal_campaigns value = 0 }
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = cwp_portugal_campaigns add = 1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					c:OVM ?= this
					c:MKU ?= this
					c:GNB ?= this
				}
				is_subject_of = c:POR
			}
			add_liberty_desire = -10
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 15
		if = { limit = { has_law = law_type:law_autocracy } add = 10 }
	}
}

cwp_portugal_colonatos_button = {
	name = "cwp_portugal_colonatos_button"
	desc = "cwp_portugal_colonatos_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:POR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_button_cooldown_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_portugal_colonatos_button_cd }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = {
			name = cwp_portugal_colonatos_button_cd
			months = 36
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_portugal_colonatos_cost
			months = 24
			multiplier = money_amount_multiplier_small
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					c:OVM ?= this
					c:MKU ?= this
				}
				is_subject_of = c:POR
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = cwp_portugal_colonatos_colony
				months = 24
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 5
	}
}

cwp_portugal_decolonize_button = {
	name = "cwp_portugal_decolonize_button"
	desc = "cwp_portugal_decolonize_button_desc"

	visible = {
		c:POR ?= this
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_portugal_not_decolonized_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = cwp_portugal_decolonize }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = cwp_portugal_decolonize_button_possible_tt
			NOR = {
				has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
				has_law = law_type:law_single_party_state
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		set_variable = cwp_portugal_decolonize
		custom_tooltip = cwp_portugal_decolonize_button_effect_tt
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 3
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
					has_law = law_type:law_single_party_state
				}
			}
			add = 30
		}
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = cwp_portugal_fronts global_var:cwp_portugal_fronts >= 2 } add = 20 }
	}
}
